description: This file defines a React component 'SkillManagementCard' used for managing learner skills, including fetching and updating learning profiles, displaying skills, and handling user interactions for adding or removing skills.

methods.name: SkillManagementCard
methods.description: Main React component for managing learner skills, with state management and UI rendering.

methods.name: handleAddSkill
methods.description: Handles addition of a new skill with specified proficiency, updating the profile and refreshing data.

methods.name: handleRemoveSkill
methods.description: Handles removal of a skill from the profile and updates the state.
